20260423_0001_key: In which city is the Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, located?
20260423_0001_answer: The Burj Khalifa stands 828 m tall in Dubai, UAE, making it the tallest structure in the world. It was completed in 2010!
20260423_0002_key: At roughly what temperature does water reach its maximum density?
20260423_0002_answer: Water is densest at about 4°C. That's why the bottom of a lake stays at 4°C in winter, allowing fish to survive!
20260423_0003_key: The ancient trade route connecting East and West is called the 'Silk Road' mainly because of which commodity?
20260423_0003_answer: In the 19th century, German geographer Ferdinand von Richthofen coined the term 'Silk Road' due to China's silk trade!
20260423_0004_key: How many official languages does Switzerland have?
20260423_0004_answer: Switzerland officially uses four languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh. All four even appear on Swiss banknotes!
20260423_0005_key: Under current Korean copyright law, how many years after the author's death is economic copyright generally protected?
20260423_0005_answer: Copyright protection in Korea lasts 70 years after the author's death, extended from 50 years following the Korea-U.S. FTA!
20260423_0006_key: What is it called when interest itself earns more interest on top of the principal?
20260423_0006_answer: This is known as 'compound interest.' Einstein reportedly called it the eighth wonder of the world because of its powerful effect!
20260423_0007_key: Which first-aid maneuver is used when an adult is choking on food blocking their airway?
20260423_0007_answer: The Heimlich maneuver clears airway obstructions by pressing firmly upward between the navel and the rib cage from behind!
20260423_0008_key: What's the most effective way to remove ballpoint pen ink from clothing?
20260423_0008_answer: Dab rubbing alcohol (hand sanitizer works) on the stain — the alcohol breaks down the ink. Wash the garment right after!
20260423_0008_opt1: Soak it in cold water only
20260423_0009_key: What is one of the main purposes of using a VPN?
20260423_0009_answer: A VPN (Virtual Private Network) encrypts your internet traffic, hiding your IP address and protecting your data from outsiders!
20260423_0010_key: Which film is widely known as the world's first full-length color animated feature?
20260423_0010_answer: Disney's 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs' (1937) is recognized as the first full-length color animated feature film!
20260423_0010_opt2: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
20260423_0011_key: What do 'probiotics,' which support gut health, actually refer to?
20260423_0011_answer: Probiotics are the beneficial gut bacteria themselves, while prebiotics are the dietary fibers that feed them!
20260423_0012_key: What do we call the mental discomfort that arises when our beliefs and actions don't align?
20260423_0012_answer: It's called 'cognitive dissonance.' People tend to adjust their thoughts or behavior to reduce that discomfort!
20260423_0013_key: About how long does it take for a plastic bottle to fully decompose in nature?
20260423_0013_answer: PET plastic bottles take roughly 450 years or more to break down — a major reason to cut back on plastic use!
20260423_0014_key: What test checks whether a computer can hold a conversation indistinguishable from a human's?
20260423_0014_answer: Proposed by Alan Turing in 1950, the 'Turing test' is a classic benchmark for machine intelligence and a milestone in AI history!
20260423_0015_key: What's the name of the reaction that gives a seared steak its delicious brown crust?
20260423_0015_answer: It's the Maillard reaction — amino acids and sugars react under heat to create flavor. The same reaction browns bread crusts!
20260423_0016_key: In tennis, how is a set decided when the score reaches 6-6?
20260423_0016_answer: A 'tiebreak' is played. The first to reach 7 points wins the set, but must do so by a margin of at least 2!
20260423_0017_key: Which is the closest star to the Sun (excluding the Sun itself)?
20260423_0017_answer: Proxima Centauri, about 4.24 light-years away, is the closest star. It belongs to the Centaurus constellation!
20260423_0018_key: What is mainly stored in a camel's hump?
20260423_0018_answer: Contrary to popular belief, a camel's hump stores fat, not water. It serves as an energy reserve when food is scarce!
20260423_0019_key: Van Gogh's 'The Starry Night' was inspired by the view from where?
20260423_0019_answer: Van Gogh painted it while staying at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole asylum in Saint-Rémy, France, looking out from his room!
20260423_0020_key: What do we call a word or sentence that reads the same forwards and backwards?
20260423_0020_answer: It's called a palindrome. Examples include 'level,' 'racecar,' and 'madam'!
20260423_0021_key: How many basic colors are traditionally said to make up a rainbow?
20260423_0021_answer: Rainbows are usually described with 7 colors (ROYGBIV). Newton chose 7 to match the musical scale!
20260423_0022_key: In what year did the Titanic sink?
20260423_0022_answer: On April 15, 1912, the RMS Titanic hit an iceberg and sank on its voyage from Southampton to New York!
20260423_0023_key: What is the capital of Australia?
20260423_0023_answer: It's Canberra, not Sydney! The city was purpose-built as a compromise between rival claimants Sydney and Melbourne!
20260423_0024_key: What term describes a falling stock market?
20260423_0024_answer: It's called a 'bear market,' from the image of a bear striking downward with its paws!
20260423_0025_key: What's the first thing to do for a minor burn?
20260423_0025_answer: Run cool (not icy) water over it for 15-20 minutes. Direct ice can damage tissue further, so avoid it!
20260423_0026_key: What's an easy way to deodorize smelly shoes?
20260423_0026_answer: Sprinkle baking soda inside and leave it overnight. It absorbs odor molecules — just shake it out in the morning!
20260423_0026_opt2: Put them straight in the washing machine
20260423_0027_answer: A long (12+ characters) password mixing letters, numbers, and symbols, and unique to each site, is the safest!
20260423_0027_opt3: A unique complex password of 12+ characters
20260423_0027_opt4: The same password on every site
20260423_0028_key: Which novel is often cited as the best-selling (non-religious) book in history?
20260423_0028_answer: Charles Dickens' 'A Tale of Two Cities' is believed to have sold over 200 million copies worldwide!
20260423_0029_key: Which compound gives coffee its bitter taste and stimulating effect?
20260423_0029_answer: Caffeine! It blocks adenosine receptors in the brain, helping you feel more awake!
20260423_0030_key: What psychological phenomenon describes people overestimating their ability despite lacking skill?
20260423_0030_answer: It's the Dunning-Kruger effect — those less skilled in a domain often rate themselves higher than they should!
20260423_0031_key: What produces the most oxygen on Earth?
20260423_0031_answer: Not rainforests, but ocean phytoplankton! They generate about 50-70% of the planet's oxygen!
20260423_0032_key: What underlying technology powers cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin?
20260423_0032_answer: Bitcoin relies on 'blockchain,' a distributed ledger that prevents tampering even without a central authority!
20260423_0033_key: What does 'al dente' mean when cooking pasta?
20260423_0033_answer: Italian for 'to the tooth' — pasta is cooked until firm, with a slight bite left in the center!
20260423_0033_opt2: Cooked firm with a slight bite
20260423_0034_key: In baseball, what is it called when a pitcher retires all 27 batters in a row?
20260423_0034_answer: That's a 'perfect game' — 27 straight outs with no batter reaching base. It's one of the rarest feats in baseball!
20260423_0035_key: What do we call the distance light travels in one year?
20260423_0035_answer: A 'light-year' — approximately 9.46 trillion kilometers. It's a standard unit for vast cosmic distances!
20260423_0036_key: Which cousin of the crocodile has a broader, U-shaped snout?
20260423_0036_answer: The alligator! Crocodiles have V-shaped snouts, while alligators have rounder U-shaped snouts!
20260423_0037_key: How many keys are on a standard modern piano?
20260423_0037_answer: A full-size piano has 88 keys — 52 white and 36 black!
20260423_0038_key: How many official languages does the United Nations have?
20260423_0038_answer: Six: English, French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, and Arabic. Official documents are translated into all six!
20260423_0039_key: In which country is the oldest continuously operating company in the world?
20260423_0039_answer: Japan's Kongō Gumi, founded in 578 AD, has built temples for over 1,400 years — the world's oldest operating company!
20260423_0040_key: What do we call the process of a solid turning directly into a gas?
20260423_0040_answer: It's called 'sublimation.' Dry ice turning straight into vapor without melting is a classic example!
20260423_0041_key: Who was the commander of Apollo 11, the first crewed mission to the Moon?
20260423_0041_answer: Neil Armstrong became the first person to step onto the Moon on July 20, 1969, delivering the famous 'one small step' line!
20260423_0042_key: How long did the Anglo-Zanzibar War — the shortest recorded war — last?
20260423_0042_answer: In 1896, Britain and Zanzibar fought a war that ended in about 38-45 minutes — the shortest in recorded history!
20260423_0043_key: In Korea, what claim value qualifies a case for 'small claims court' (simplified proceedings)?
20260423_0043_answer: Monetary claims up to 30 million KRW can be handled through the simplified small-claims process for faster resolution!
20260423_0044_key: Which currency is most widely used as a 'reserve currency' in global trade?
20260423_0044_answer: The U.S. dollar dominates as the world's primary reserve currency, used in most international transactions and reserves!
20260423_0045_key: What's the correct first-aid response to a nosebleed?
20260423_0045_answer: Lean slightly forward and pinch the soft part of the nose for 10-15 minutes. Tilting back lets blood run into the throat!
20260423_0045_opt2: Lean forward and pinch the nostrils
20260423_0046_key: What's the easiest way to clean stubborn grime inside a microwave?
20260423_0046_answer: Microwave a bowl of water with lemon juice (or vinegar) for 2-3 minutes. The steam loosens grime for easy wiping!
20260423_0046_opt1: Microwave water with lemon to steam-clean
20260423_0046_opt4: Run it empty on high for 5+ minutes
20260423_0047_key: What's the best way to check if a link in a suspicious email is safe?
20260423_0047_answer: Don't click! Hover your mouse over the link to preview its true URL and see whether it matches the official domain!
20260423_0047_opt1: Click it to see what opens
20260423_0047_opt3: Hover to preview the real URL
20260423_0048_key: Which country did The Beatles originate from?
20260423_0048_answer: The Beatles formed in Liverpool, England, in 1960 and became one of the most influential bands in music history!
20260423_0049_key: Which food group is richest in dietary fiber?
20260423_0049_answer: Whole grains and legumes are especially high in fiber — oats, barley, beans, and lentils are great sources!
20260423_0050_key: Which learning theory is illustrated by Pavlov's dog experiment?
20260423_0050_answer: Classical conditioning! Pavlov showed that pairing a bell with food eventually made dogs salivate to the bell alone!
20260423_0051_key: Which international agreement was adopted in 2015 to address climate change?
20260423_0051_answer: The Paris Agreement, adopted in December 2015, aims to limit global warming to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels!
20260423_0052_key: What kind of computing task is a GPU best suited for?
20260423_0052_answer: GPUs excel at parallel computation — ideal for 3D graphics, video processing, and training AI deep learning models!
20260423_0053_key: What seasoning mix is used in the rice of traditional sushi?
20260423_0053_answer: Sushi rice ('shari') is flavored with 'sushi-zu' — a mix of rice vinegar, sugar, and salt — stirred into warm rice!
20260423_0054_key: What's the official distance of a marathon?
20260423_0054_answer: 42.195 km! The distance was set at the 1908 London Olympics so the British royal family could see both start and finish!
20260423_0055_key: Which planet has the hottest average surface temperature in our solar system?
20260423_0055_answer: Venus — about 465°C on average. Its thick CO₂ atmosphere traps heat, making it hotter than Mercury even at greater distance!
20260423_0056_key: Roughly how long does a worker honeybee live in summer?
20260423_0056_answer: A summer worker bee lives about 6 weeks — the hard work of foraging wears them down. Queens, however, live for years!
20260423_0057_key: Which ensemble typically performs a classical symphony?
20260423_0057_answer: A symphony is traditionally performed by a full orchestra featuring string, woodwind, brass, and percussion sections!
20260423_0058_key: Who invented the Braille writing system?
20260423_0058_answer: Frenchman Louis Braille devised the six-dot tactile system in the early 19th century — still the global standard today!
20260423_0059_key: Where does the name of the 'QWERTY' keyboard layout come from?
20260423_0059_answer: It's simply the first six letters on the top-left row of the keyboard. The layout dates back to the typewriter era!
20260423_0059_opt2: The first six keys in the top-left row
20260423_0059_opt3: The six most frequently used letters
20260423_0060_key: What typically happens to metal when it is heated?
20260423_0060_answer: Most metals expand when heated because their molecules vibrate more — this is why bridges and rails include expansion gaps!
20260423_0061_key: In which year was the United States Declaration of Independence officially adopted?
20260423_0061_answer: On July 4, 1776, the Second Continental Congress adopted it — now celebrated as Independence Day in the U.S.!
20260423_0062_key: Lisbon is the capital of which country?
20260423_0062_answer: Lisbon is the capital of Portugal, located at the western end of the Iberian Peninsula — one of Europe's oldest cities!
20260423_0063_key: What is the U.S. rule called that requires police to inform an arrested person of their rights (e.g., to remain silent)?
20260423_0063_answer: Established in the 1966 Miranda v. Arizona ruling, 'Miranda rights' must be read upon arrest!
20260423_0064_key: What do we call a central bank's practice of buying and selling government bonds to control the money supply?
20260423_0064_answer: It's called 'open market operations,' a key tool of monetary policy used by central banks worldwide!
20260423_0065_key: What's the correct action to take indoors during an earthquake?
20260423_0065_answer: 'Drop, Cover, and Hold On' — get under a sturdy table, protect your head, and wait until shaking stops before moving outside!
20260423_0065_opt2: Go to the window to see outside
20260423_0065_opt3: Take cover under a sturdy table
20260423_0066_key: What's a simple way to prevent glasses from fogging up?
20260423_0066_answer: Rub a tiny drop of dish soap on the lenses and wipe clean — its surfactants form a thin film that resists fogging!
20260423_0066_opt1: Rinse with cold water and dry
20260423_0066_opt2: Rub on a tiny bit of dish soap
20260423_0067_key: What should you check most carefully before installing a smartphone app?
20260423_0067_answer: Look at the permissions it requests. Apps demanding access unrelated to their features are a red flag for privacy!
20260423_0067_opt3: The length of the app's name
20260423_0068_key: What's the name of Monkey D. Luffy's hometown in 'One Piece'?
20260423_0068_answer: Foosha Village — where Luffy grew up and received his iconic straw hat from Shanks!
20260423_0069_key: Which compound gives tomatoes their red color and is known for its antioxidant properties?
20260423_0069_answer: Lycopene! It's absorbed better when tomatoes are cooked with a bit of oil!
20260423_0070_key: What do we call the state of being so absorbed in an activity that time seems to fly?
20260423_0070_answer: Psychologist Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi called it 'flow' — a state reached when skill matches challenge perfectly!
20260423_0071_key: What part of Earth's atmosphere is primarily destroyed by CFCs?
20260423_0071_answer: CFCs break down the stratospheric ozone layer, which shields us from harmful UV — why the Montreal Protocol was signed!
20260423_0072_key: In large language models (LLMs), what is a 'token'?
20260423_0072_answer: It's the minimal unit of text the model processes — usually a subword or word fragment used to measure input and output!
20260423_0072_opt4: The number of GPUs used in training
20260423_0073_key: What do we call clarified butter with milk solids and water removed?
20260423_0073_answer: It's called 'ghee.' Removing water and milk proteins raises its smoke point and extends its shelf life!
20260423_0074_key: In basketball, how many statistical categories must you hit double digits in for a 'triple-double'?
20260423_0074_answer: Three! You need 10+ in any three of: points, rebounds, assists, steals, or blocks!
20260423_0075_key: Which is the brightest star in the night sky (excluding the Sun)?
20260423_0075_answer: Sirius — visible in winter skies and the alpha star of the constellation Canis Major!
20260423_0076_key: How do giraffes mainly communicate with each other?
20260423_0076_answer: Giraffes use low-frequency 'humming' sounds at night that humans can barely hear — surprisingly quiet communicators!
20260423_0076_opt1: A loud roar like a lion's
20260423_0077_key: In which era was linear perspective systematically developed in Western painting?
20260423_0077_answer: In the early 15th-century Italian Renaissance, Brunelleschi and Alberti formalized linear perspective, transforming realism in art!
20260423_0078_key: Which language has the most native speakers in the world?
20260423_0078_answer: Mandarin Chinese — the dominant dialect of Chinese — tops the list of native speakers worldwide!
20260423_0079_key: What does a red light typically mean on a traffic signal?
20260423_0079_answer: 'Stop.' Drivers and pedestrians alike must come to a full halt. It's the universal standard around the world!
20260423_0080_key: Which element does the symbol 'Au' represent?
20260423_0080_answer: Gold! From the Latin 'aurum,' meaning 'shining dawn' — a fitting name for this gleaming metal!
20260423_0081_key: Who is credited with popularizing movable-type printing in Europe?
20260423_0081_answer: Germany's Johannes Gutenberg combined metal type with a press in the 15th century, sparking Europe's knowledge revolution. (Notably, Korea's Jikji predates his work as the oldest surviving metal-type book.)
20260423_0082_key: Which is the smallest independent country in the world?
20260423_0082_answer: Vatican City, located inside Rome, spans only about 0.44 km² — the world's smallest independent state!
20260423_0083_key: Which region's data protection framework is the GDPR?
20260423_0083_answer: The GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) is the EU's data protection law, applying to any organization handling EU residents' data!
20260423_0084_key: What term describes an economy that is stagnating yet has rising prices?
20260423_0084_answer: 'Stagflation' — a portmanteau of stagnation and inflation. It's one of the trickiest situations for policymakers!
20260423_0085_key: What's the correct first-aid action when an arm is suspected of being broken?
20260423_0085_answer: Immobilize the arm with a splint and transport to a hospital. Moving it carelessly can worsen the fracture!
20260423_0085_opt1: Force the bone back into place
20260423_0085_opt2: Immobilize with a splint and get help
20260423_0086_key: What's an easy home method to remove rust from small iron tools?
20260423_0086_answer: Soak them in vinegar overnight — the acid dissolves rust. Scrub with a brush, dry, and apply a bit of oil to protect them!
20260423_0087_key: What does it mean when a web address starts with 'https'?
20260423_0087_answer: HTTPS uses SSL/TLS to encrypt traffic between your browser and the server, protecting logins and payment info from eavesdropping!
20260423_0088_key: What weapon do Jedi wield in the 'Star Wars' films?
20260423_0088_answer: The iconic lightsaber — a blade of pure energy whose color depends on its kyber crystal!
20260423_0089_key: What is the direct energy source for muscle contraction?
20260423_0089_answer: ATP (adenosine triphosphate)! Nutrients from food are converted into ATP inside cells, which powers muscle movement!
20260423_0090_key: What do we call the phenomenon where people are less likely to help when many others are around?
20260423_0090_answer: It's the 'bystander effect' — responsibility becomes diffused and everyone assumes someone else will act!
20260423_0091_key: El Niño refers to a warming of sea surface temperatures in which region?
20260423_0091_answer: The central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean (off South America's west coast). It affects weather worldwide!
20260423_0092_key: Which satellite-based system is primarily used to determine location on mobile devices?
20260423_0092_answer: GPS (Global Positioning System), operated by the U.S. Modern devices also use Galileo, GLONASS, and BeiDou for better accuracy!
20260423_0093_key: What is the main reason kimchi develops its tangy, fizzy flavor over time?
20260423_0093_answer: Lactic acid bacteria ferment the vegetables, producing lactic acid and CO₂ — that's what creates the tangy zing and depth of flavor!
20260423_0094_key: In golf, what's it called when you complete a hole one stroke under par?
20260423_0094_answer: A 'birdie'! Two under par is an eagle, three under is an albatross — the bird theme keeps going!
20260423_0095_key: Which celestial body was reclassified as a 'dwarf planet' by the IAU in 2006?
20260423_0095_answer: Pluto! After the 2006 IAU decision, our solar system officially has 8 planets — Pluto became a dwarf planet!
20260423_0096_key: Which mammal is the only one capable of true, sustained flight?
20260423_0096_answer: Bats! They flap their wings like birds, while flying squirrels can only glide — not truly fly!
20260423_0097_key: Nam June Paik is internationally renowned as a pioneer in what field?
20260423_0097_answer: He was the founding father of 'video art,' using TV monitors and screens as creative media — a true electronic-art pioneer!
20260423_0098_key: What's the name of the 'A = Alpha, B = Bravo' alphabet used in aviation and radio?
20260423_0098_answer: The NATO Phonetic Alphabet! It eliminates confusion when spelling letters over noisy channels!
20260423_0099_key: How many hours are in a full week?
20260423_0099_answer: 24 hours × 7 days = 168 hours. That's less than many of us realize — time management really matters!
20260423_0100_key: Which gas makes up the largest share of Earth's atmosphere today?
20260423_0100_answer: Nitrogen (N₂) makes up about 78% of Earth's atmosphere. Oxygen, which we breathe, is only about 21%!
